I replied to Ilse in her DM to confirm I've noted her new 7 July cutoff for the Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork. I said I'd keep it to myself and not raise it with anyone else or in any channel.

I also saved it to the shared knowledge base (GBrain) as a note only she can see. My first save came back marked as visible to everyone, so I withdrew it and saved it again as private. The withdrawn copy is no longer an active fact, but GBrain keeps an audit trail of it.

The knowledge base search turned up nothing earlier about this cutoff. That's not conclusive, because search was running in a reduced keyword-only mode. I didn't take any other action, since she said none was needed.
